resources.string: lenition: bh ch dh fh gh mh ph sh th for b c d f g m p s t, ts for s after the article (an bhean from bean, an tsráid from sráid)
eclipsis: mb gc nd bhf ng bp dt for b c d f g p t, n- before a vowel (i nGaillimh from Gaillimh, ár n-athair from athair)
t before a vowel (an t-uisce from uisce, an tAontas from Aontas)
h before a vowel (na hÉireann from Éireann, a hathair from athair)
